bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest recent story out of Chicago is the Bears' gritty 27-24 overtime-scare win over the Buccaneers, as the defense bailed out quarterback Caleb Williams after he threw four interceptions, with Cairo Santos' late field goal sealing the victory. The win was overshadowed by injury concerns, as wide receiver Luther Burden was helped off the field and later confirmed by head coach Ben Johnson to have suffered a concussion, while cornerback Kyler Gordon also exited the game with an injury.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions made a move ahead of the NFL trade deadline, acquiring veteran safety Andre Cisco from the Jets in exchange for a 2028 sixth-round pick, per ESPN's Adam Schefter, with Cisco set to become an unrestricted free agent in 2027 . The trade comes as Detroit sits at 6-2 entering Week 10 after their big win over Miami on Sunday , bolstering a secondary that has dealt with injuries this season.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers delivered a dominant 45-27 win over the New England Patriots on Sunday, with wide receivers Matthew Golden and Christian Watson delivering historic performances in what was described as the team's best performance of the 2026 season . The victory came with a significant cost, however, as running back Josh Jacobs broke the ring finger on his right hand during the win over New England , leaving his availability for the next game uncertain.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings are preparing to host the Buffalo Bills on Monday Night Football with their quarterback situation in flux, as Carson Wentz is starting after Minnesota made a QB change due to Kyler Murray's hamstring injury , which has left Murray week-to-week. Adding to the storylines, the Vikings are signing Odell Beckham Jr.
